steps.name: overlay-gone
steps.failMessage: 'Opening floor plan' overlay did not auto-hide. Asserted on the overlay ELEMENT unmounting, not on the label text: a text `visible: false` ignores opacity and is also satisfied BEFORE React renders the label, so it can pass vacuously (v0.31.8.93).
